description: The QR code image for one of the user's CVs, pointing to its public QR link — for business cards, events and printed CVs. PRO. Needs an active QR link first (create_takemeup_share_link with purpose "qr").

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: get_takemeup_qr_code
title: Pocket QR code (PRO)
